California Navy Tieks - Italian Leather Ballet Flats
These California Navy ballet flats provide an effortless, elegant look for a day on the boat or an evening on the town. Made with premium, soft, top-grain Italian leather. Non-elasticized, cushioned back and padded instep. Foldable split-sole design for ultimate portability. Signature Tiek Blue stripes and durable, non-skid rubber soles.

Perricone MD Neuropeptide Firming Moisturizer
An anti-aging moisturizer to repair severe loss of elasticity and deliver antioxidant protection. With Alpha Lipoic Acid, DMAE and Vitamin C Ester.
